card.name: Future-oriented words in news text
card.fires_on: Words in general news or science text that look ahead to later events, such as future, one day, will continue, aims to, or projected time spans. The marked word is often a small linking word or the noun right after a future cue.

modes.label: Future-looking phrasing
modes.description: Words inside statements about plans, predictions or what will happen later.
modes.example: the team aims<< to>> do more 1-km tests next

modes.label: Future time spans
modes.description: Numbers or nouns in projected durations or upcoming items.
modes.example: Japan may need longer than the projected <<4>>0 years to clean up the site.

card.writes: It pushes toward odd non-English or rare word pieces and away from Chinese words meaning continue, next year or upcoming, so there is no clear forward-looking output.
card.plain: It lights up on words in news stories that talk about what will happen in the future.
evidence: the team aims<< to>> do more 1-km tests next
Astronauts will need to make similarly precise landings on Mars<< one>> day.
It is unclear at this time how future<< offerings>> of the watershed academy will be presented.
